messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for Terracore (enterprise) in us-west-2 dedicated pool (terrafirma-vpc). p95=1.2s -> 3.8s, p99=200ms -> 7.3s. Triggered at 2025-11-02T15:27:09Z. Paging on-call. Ticket INC-5423.
Alex G.: Paging Priya (oncall). Terracore is our largest tenant on that pool — high customer impact.
oncall-bot: @Priya S. has been paged (pagerduty#789).
Priya S.: Acked. I'm in — pulling Grafana + flamegraphs now. Link: https://grafana.redwood/terracore/usw2/dedicated/pool
Priya S.: Quick check: noisy tenant hypothesis. Seeing a sustained tail with lots of long-context chat completions (seq_len ~2k). KV cache miss spikes too.
Jamal R.: If it's a tenant causing monstrous requests we should isolate before scaling. We can flip tenant to isolated pool (cold-evict) and route to warm spare in us-east-1.
Maya L.: Agreed. Plan: 1) isolate tenant terrafirma-terracore-01 2) enable model-fallback to smaller variant (gpt-compat-7b) for that tenant 3) scale pool by +30% temporarily.
Priya S.: Running isolation now — command: ``/api/v1/tenants/isolate?tenant_id=terrafirma-terracore-01&mode=drain``. I'll set traffic to sticky-fallback via routing policy.
incident-bot: Action logged: tenant isolation requested by Priya S. (action_id: A-98765).
Ops-SRE: If isolation fails, we can do immediate tenant eviction and apply per-tenant rate limit: ``tenant_rate_limit: 50req/min``. Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for their workload.
Alex G.: Customer comm draft (short): "We detected elevated latency from your dedicated pool in us-west-2. We're isolating the affected tenant and failing over traffic to our warm spare; no data loss anticipated. Will update in 15m." Approve?
Priya S.: Approve send. I'll post to their support channel + CSM.
Jamal R.: Scaling invocation: ``kubectl -n inference scale deployment terrad-pool --replicas=13`` and runtime: ``redwoodctl pool scale --pool-id=usw2-dedicated-7 --percent=30``. Executing now.
Maya L.: Also enabling fallback model: ``redwoodctl tenant set-routing --tenant terrafirma-terracore-01 --fallback-model gpt-compat-7b``. Done.
Priya S.: Isolation succeeded, traffic shifted to warm spare (us-east-1). Observability: p99 dropped from 7.3s -> 420ms within 90s. p95 trending down.
incident-bot: INC-5423 status updated: mitigation in progress. Postmortem owner assigned: Maya L.
Alex G.: Great work. Next steps: monitor for 30m, collect sample prompts for eval, run cost impact calc, prepare RCA. Update cadence every 15m.
Priya S.: Noting ETA for full recovery: 30-45m barring additional noisy tenants. I'll keep this thread updated.
Maya L.: I'll open a follow-up runbook item: add per-tenant soft QPS guard and an automatic model-fallback policy for heavy seq_len workloads.
Alex G.: Thanks everyone. Stand down only after p99 < 500ms for 30m.
Priya S.: 15m update: p99=380ms, customer-facing message posted. Continuing to monitor.
summary: Customer Terracore in terrafirma-vpc experienced a p99 latency spike in us-west-2 dedicated pool. On-call isolated noisy tenant, failed over traffic to warm spare region, enabled model fallback and scaled pool. p99 reduced from 7.3s to ~380ms. Mitigation in progress; postmortem assigned.
